knowledge:
- key_parameters: isCount=Logical indicating if input data is count data, which triggers log-transformations and count-specific DE methods ;; reduceMethod=Method for dimensionality reduction, such as "PCA", "var", or "mad" ;; nReducedDims=Number of dimensions to retain when using PCA reduction ;; nFilterDims=Number of most variable features to retain when using filtering reductions ;; ks=Range of cluster numbers (k) to evaluate in clusterMany ;; alphas=Significance/cutoff parameters for type '01' clustering algorithms ;; consensusProportion=Minimum proportion of co-clustering required to group samples in makeConsensus ;; consensusMinSize=Minimum cluster size; smaller clusters are set to unassigned (-1) ;; mergeMethod=Method for estimating the proportion of DE genes for merging sister clusters (e.g., "adjP", "JC", "Storey") ;; mergeCutoff=Cutoff for the proportion of DE genes below which sister clusters are merged ;; DEMethod=Differential expression method used for merging or finding features (e.g., "edgeR", "limma") ;; makeMissingDiss=If FALSE, prevents calculation of NxN distance matrices to save memory on large datasets ;; removeDup=If TRUE, reduces the NxB matrix of clusterings to unique rows to avoid large NxN matrix calculations in consensus clustering
- alternatives: mbkmeans=A mini-batch k-means clustering algorithm recommended for extremely large datasets, especially when integrated with HDF5 files to avoid bringing the entire dataset into memory ;; limma/edgeR/MAST=Packages used for downstream differential expression analysis; getBestFeatures wraps limma and edgeR, while clusterContrasts formats contrasts for MAST
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing high-dimensional transcriptomics data (especially single-cell RNA-seq) where clustering results are highly sensitive to parameter choices, and a robust, consensus-based clustering is desired.
- pitfalls: Calculating NxN distance/similarity matrices (e.g., using PAM, hierarchical clustering, or silhouette width calculations) on very large datasets can cause out-of-memory errors; use makeMissingDiss=FALSE to prevent this ;; Subsampling and consensus clustering historically calculate NxN matrices; use clusterArgs=list(removeDup=TRUE) to mitigate this ;; Using HDF5 files with default clustering routines will bring the entire matrix into memory; only mbkmeans natively avoids this ;; Performing DE analysis on clusters defined by the same data inflates p-values (exploratory only) ;; Subsetting a ClusterExperiment object deletes the saved cluster hierarchy (dendrogram) and merge info

workflows.name: rsec_automated_pipeline
workflows.intent: Run the complete automated RSEC pipeline to generate a robust consensus clustering, build a hierarchy, merge similar clusters, and find marker features.
input: fluidigmData (list of count and TPM matrices)
workflows.stages: 1. Initialize SummarizedExperiment with count data ;; 2. Filter out lowly expressed genes ;; 3. Normalize counts and add as an assay ;; 4. Run the unified RSEC wrapper ;; 5. Retrieve and visualize the primary cluster and cluster matrix ;; 6. Perform differential expression to find cluster-specific marker features ;; 7. Visualize marker features using heatmaps
workflows.code:
library(clusterExperiment)
data(fluidigmData) ## list of the two datasets (tophat_counts and rsem_tpm)
data(fluidigmColData)
se<-SummarizedExperiment(fluidigmData,colData=fluidigmColData)
wh_zero <- which(rowSums(assay(se))==0)
pass_filter <- apply(assay(se), 1, function(x) length(x[x >= 10]) >= 10)
se <- se[pass_filter,]
fq <- round(limma::normalizeQuantiles(assay(se)))
assays(se) <- c(SimpleList(normalized_counts=fq),assays(se))
wh<-which(colnames(colData(se)) %in% c("Cluster1","Cluster2"))
colnames(colData(se))[wh]<-c("Published1","Published2")
rsecFluidigm<-RSEC(se, isCount = TRUE, reduceMethod="PCA", nReducedDims=10, k0s = 4:15, alphas=c(0.1, 0.2, 0.3), ncores=1, random.seed=176201)
primaryCluster(rsecFluidigm)
tableClusters(rsecFluidigm)
clusterMatrix(rsecFluidigm)
plotClusters(rsecFluidigm,main="Clusters from RSEC", whichClusters="workflow", colData=c("Biological_Condition","Published2"), axisLine=-1)
pairsAllRSEC<-getBestFeatures(rsecFluidigm,contrastType="Pairs",p.value=0.05, number=nrow(rsecFluidigm),DEMethod="edgeR")
plotHeatmap(rsecFluidigm, whichClusters=c("makeConsensus","mergeClusters"),clusterSamplesData="dendrogramValue", clusterFeaturesData=unique(pairsAllRSEC[,"IndexInOriginal"]), main="Heatmap of features w/ significant pairwise differences", breaks=.99)
plotContrastHeatmap(rsecFluidigm, signif=pairsAllRSEC,nBlankLines=40,whichCluster="primary")

workflows.name: manual_step_by_step_clustering
workflows.intent: Manually execute and fine-tune each step of the clustering workflow (clusterMany, makeConsensus, makeDendrogram, mergeClusters) to have granular control over parameters.
input: se (SummarizedExperiment object containing normalized transcriptomic data)
workflows.stages: 1. Run multiple clusterings across parameter combinations using clusterMany ;; 2. Generate a consensus clustering using makeConsensus with custom proportions ;; 3. Build a cluster hierarchy using makeDendrogram ;; 4. Merge similar clusters based on DE testing using mergeClusters ;; 5. Assign unassigned samples to the nearest cluster using assignUnassigned ;; 6. Visualize the workflow progression using plotClustersWorkflow and plotCoClustering
workflows.code:
ce<-clusterMany(se, clusterFunction="pam",ks=5:10, minSizes=5, isCount=TRUE,reduceMethod=c("PCA","var"),nFilterDims=c(100,500,1000), nReducedDims=c(5,15,50),run=TRUE)
plotClusters(ce,main="Clusters from clusterMany", whichClusters="workflow", colData=c("Biological_Condition","Published2"), axisLine=-1)
ce<-makeConsensus(ce,proportion=1)
wh<-which(clusterLabels(ce)=="makeConsensus")
if(length(wh)!=1) stop() else clusterLabels(ce)[wh]<-"makeConsensus,1"
ce<-makeConsensus(ce,proportion=0.7,clusterLabel="makeConsensus,0.7")
ce<-makeConsensus(ce,proportion=0.7,minSize=3,clusterLabel="makeConsensus,final")
plotCoClustering(ce)
ce<-makeDendrogram(ce,reduceMethod="var",nDims=500)
plotDendrogram(ce)
mergeClusters(ce,mergeMethod="adjP",DEMethod="edgeR",plotInfo="mergeMethod")
ce<-mergeClusters(ce,mergeMethod="adjP",DEMethod="edgeR",cutoff=0.05)
ce<-assignUnassigned(ce,whichCluster="mergeClusters",reduceMethod="PCA",nDim=50,makePrimary=FALSE, filterIgnoresUnassigned=TRUE,clusterLabel="mergeClusters_AssignToCluster")
plotClustersWorkflow(ce,whichClusters="workflow")
